snippet.title: Enigmo (Windows game 2003)
snippet.description:
Enigmo is a 3D graphics unique puzzle game by Pangea Software, Ideas From the Deep, MumboJumbo.
The objective is to move liquid droplets into the container using bumpers and slides.
